keyFindings.description: The stale-lease takeover renames whatever is at the lease path. Two contenders that both judged the same stale lease (the design's own case: a SIGKILLed pod, six role containers relaunching together): A renames it aside and re-creates a fresh lease at attempt 1; B's rename then moves A's live lease aside (rename only fails ENOENT when the path is absent), B removes it and creates its own, and both run codegraph init/index on one workspace — the SQLite corruption lines 125-130 say this file exists to prevent. The comment at 216-217 ('the one step two contenders cannot both win') holds only while the path is empty between A's rename and A's create. Fix direction: verify the renamed-aside file is the one judged stale (os.SameFile against the stat at 246) and restore it otherwise, or serialize takeovers on a second O_EXCL marker (itself stale past warmLeaseStale), or renameat2 RENAME_EXCHANGE; whichever, a test that drives the interleaving deterministically.

warmUpDrain (10 s) is reasoned against 'the launcher's 30 s stop grace', but a pod's launcher always runs with --stop-grace <TerminationGrace> = worker_stop_timeout_seconds, default 10 s (internal/runtime/sandbox/manifest.go:394, internal/config/config.go:179); the launcher's 30 s is only its unset fallback (internal/launcher/launcher.go:46-47). Worst case after the group SIGTERM: Grace 5 s + drainTimeout 1 s + warmUpDrain 10 s = 16 s > 10 s, so the launcher SIGKILLs the shim with the lease still held — the failure the drain was added to prevent. The measured path is 0.12-0.30 s, so this is the bound and the comment, not an observed failure: bound the drain by the role's actual grace (Config carries Grace already) or set it under worker_stop_timeout - Grace - drainTimeout, and correct the comment.

A rename that fails ENOENT is read as 'another process took over' and the warm-up skips, but the holder releasing (os.Remove at 292) between the stat at 246 and the rename produces the same ENOENT with the lease free: one launch's warm-up is lost for nothing and the log line is false. Continue into the existing one retry instead, as the stat ENOENT branch at 247-248 does.
